source: ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Carbonyl sulfide" (ChemSep index 1893, CAS 463-58-1). Molecular weight, normal boiling point, Tc, Pc and acentric factor as given; standard liquid density: eq. 105 saturated liquid at 288.7056 K (60 F), as the bundled light ends; ideal-gas Cp eq. 16 (A=28351, B=-363.89, C=10.752, D=-0.00019902, E=7.0945e-8; data 100..1500 K) fitted by least squares as shifted_polynomial_5 over 134.3..900 K (32 points), largest deviation -0.272 % at 134.3 K, 0.110 % over 298.15..900 K; viscosity tables and freezing data in their entries. Owner decision 2026-11-04: Tc 378.77 K, Pc 6.3688 MPa and acentric factor 0.0978 are CoolProp 8.0.0's (Lemmon and Span, JCED 2006), as listed in REFINERY_COMPOUNDS_DATA.md section 2 (batch 2026-11-04-refinery-compounds), replacing ChemSep's inconsistent 375.15 K, 6.349 MPa and 0.137779 (its own eq. 101 and 105 run to 378.8 K); every Tc-dependent value follows the new Tc, the ChemSep correlations are kept. Imported by tools/compound-import.

fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network only (not the column range): the ideal-gas Cp fit range, from max(ChemSep Cp data start, triple point) to 900 K; below it Cp is held and integrated, with a notice (a data-range end, never a validity floor). 100 Pa..2000000 Pa as the bundled light ends: PR78 from ChemSep critical constants, not qualified above that.

thermochemistry.source: Ideal-gas heat of formation at 298.15 K and formula COS (molar mass 60.07 g/mol) of ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Carbonyl sulfide" (ChemSep index 1893, CAS 463-58-1). No limits: Bulletin 627 Table A-1 has no carbonyl sulfide entry, and the values entered from memory (12 and 29 vol%) are unverified. Heats of reaction follow by Hess's law. Data only.

liquid.source: ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Carbonyl sulfide" (ChemSep index 1893, CAS 463-58-1): liquid viscosity eq. 101 (A=-9.091, B=494.42, C=-0.20653, D=-6.4588e-7, E=2; data 134.3..300.12 K), sampled over max(data start, triple point) to 0.95 Tc into a log table by recursive bisection, log interpolation within 0.05 % at quarter and mid points. Past the data end, 300.12..359.83149999999995 K: estimated, ln(mu) linear in 1/T at the equation's slope at 300.12 K (Andrade form). No pressure correction; the parser continues the table past its ends.

freezing.source: ChemSep v8.3 pure component data (Copyright (c) Harry Kooijman and Ross Taylor; Artistic License 2.0), as embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (DWSIM.Thermodynamics.dll resource chemsep1.xml), compound "Carbonyl sulfide" (ChemSep index 1893, CAS 463-58-1): melting point, triple point temperature and pressure, heat of fusion at the melting point.
